name: Barbell Wide-Grip Curl
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold a barbell in front of your thighs using an underhand grip wider than shoulder width.
Pin your elbows close to your sides and brace your core firmly.
Curl the bar smoothly upward toward your chest without letting your elbows drift forward.
Lower the bar slowly back to near full arm extension under control.
tips: Keep your elbows tucked beside your torso and wrists aligned straight with your forearms.
Avoid leaning backward or swinging your hips to start the curl.
